projects.name: ORBITAL STATION THETA
projects.description: Modular orbital station concept designed for deep space operations. Inspired by retro-futuristic aerospace engineering and brutalist architecture. Every panel, antenna, and docking port was individually modeled with attention to functional plausibility.

projects.name: XENOMORPH ENVIRONMENT
projects.description: Dark, atmospheric corridor environment inspired by the derelict spacecraft aesthetic. Designed to evoke tension and claustrophobia through oppressive geometry, dim emergency lighting, and organic-mechanical hybrid surfaces.

projects.name: SYNTHETIC UNIT M-CLASS
projects.description: High-detail synthetic humanoid character model. Blending organic anatomy with visible mechanical infrastructure beneath translucent skin panels. Designed as a real-time game-ready asset with full PBR material set.
